security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel (HS-mode or M-mode firmware) accesses siselect, sireg, stopei, hgeip, hgeie, hstatus.VGEIN, or relies on mip.SEIP/m sideip behavior when msdcfg.SIDN may reference an unimplemented supervisor interrupt domain, without first validating SIDN against the implemented domain count — the spec no longer defines behavior for this case (previously guaranteed SEIP=0, illegal-instruction on access, hgeip/hgeie=0, VGEIN read-only zero).
security_spec.summary: Removal of invalid-SIDN behavioral guarantees (was: SEIP=0, siselect/stopei→illegal-instruction, hgeip/hgeie=0, VGEIN read-only zero) means kernel must validate msdcfg.SIDN before any domain-dependent CSR access, or risk undefined trap/state behavior
